text:
nate: Heads-up — DAST job `nightly-dast-prod` flagged a high-severity admin-auth-bypass on /admin/login. Failing CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/nightly-dast/177
maya: saw that. logs look weird — scanner couldn't fetch session cookie from the auth fixture. pasted snippet below:
security-bot: [dast] scan-run 1777500000 started\nfetching auth fixture -> 403 from auth-proxy\nerror: unable to decrypt fixture token (KMS: AccessDenied)\n--- end snippet
linh: KMS rotation completed ~1777499900, infra reported ephemeral grants issued but scanner service account didn't get the new binding.
alice: so the finding is likely a false positive produced because the scanner couldn't authenticate and then crawled public error pages that looked like an auth bypass.
carter: +1. We saw similar flakiness last quarter when keystore TTLs lapsed. Can we re-run with a hotfix token instead of rolling back rotation?
nate: I can re-run if infra grants a temp grant. @eng-infra can you create a short-lived IAM binding for `dast-runner@ci` to decrypt the fixture key? Prefer 15m TTL.
maya: if infra can't, we should suppress this finding with evidence pointing to KMS AccessDenied and link the failing request id. I'm attaching the request id: req=6f12a3e4
linh: audit logs show a bind-change at 1777499924 by `keystore-rotation-bot`. Entry: "grant: serviceAccount:dast-runner -> kms:decrypt" was omitted due to policy filter. I'll paste event id: act=evt-77-rot
alice: suggested triage: 1) mark SAST/DAST finding as FP with evidence (KMS AccessDenied + crawler traces), 2) infra issues ephemeral grant for re-run, 3) update rotation playbook to include CI binding step and a post-rotation smoke-check
security-bot: [action] create ticket: SEC-DAST-17775 - investigate KMS rotation impact on DAST creds
carter: for the suppression, include this command output: `curl -H "x-ci-request: 6f12a3e4" https://ci.redwood.internal/api/scans/177 -s` -> returns 403 and body contains `KMS AccessDenied`. Attach that to the ticket.
maya: pinging @eng-infra on-call (alice-infra). can you confirm you can create the 15m grant? If not, we will proceed with suppression and scheduled re-run.
alice: oncall infra here — I can create a 20m grant now. creating ephemeral binding and posting creds to the secure channel.
nate: re-run queued. I'll post results in ~5m.
security-bot: [dast] rerun 1777500000 by nate queued -> build 1777500001
nate: rerun finished: no auth-bypass found. closing as false positive. I'll update the ticket with diffs and attach logs.
maya: thanks. follow-up: update rotation playbook to run `ci-dast-smoke` job and verify decrypt before rotating keys.
linh: filing a small infra PR to add the check and a unit test around service account bindings.
carter: moving to resolved once PR merged and ticket updated. :white_check_mark:
